title: 3L-Cache: Low Overhead and Precise Learning-based Eviction Policy for Caches
note: Learning-based cache eviction policy evaluated entirely by trace-driven simulation on top of libCacheSim - user-space C++, CPU only, no root, and the headline metric (CPU overhead vs miss ratio) is exactly the kind of trade-off a 10-week improvement project can attack. Concerns - the paper's 4855-trace corpus is many TB; must subset to a few trace families and argue representativeness.
